metaDescription: Calculate statutory late payment interest at the reference rate plus 8 points and the EUR 40 fixed sum for an overdue B2B invoice.
intro: Interest on an overdue invoice, split across the semesters you enter, plus the fixed recovery sum.
why:
Directive 2011/7/EU gives businesses statutory interest on late B2B payments: the reference rate plus at least eight percentage points, and a fixed sum of at least EUR 40. The reference rate is the one in force on 1 January or 1 July.

Enter the rate for each semester, the amount and the dates. Your country may set higher rates and the contract may differ. Not tax advice. Check national rules.
howTo: Enter the reference rate for each semester.
Enter the amount, due date and payment date.
Read the interest and the total claim.

faq.q: Where do I find the reference rate?
faq.a: For euro countries it is the ECB main refinancing rate. The sample values are only examples.
Simple interest on 365 days from the day after the due date.
The directive covers business transactions. Consumer rules differ.
